# Heatmap cells label-truth passes

```chart
type: heatmap
title: Small cells in a 0 to 100 domain
data:
  inline:
    - {r: a, c: x, v: 0.01}
    - {r: a, c: y, v: 0.07}
    - {r: b, c: x, v: 100}
    - {r: b, c: y, v: 0.03}
encoding: {x: c, y: r, color: v}
```

```chart
type: heatmap
title: A positive cell in a domain from minus 1 to 1000
data:
  inline:
    - {r: a, c: x, v: -1}
    - {r: a, c: y, v: 0.03}
    - {r: b, c: x, v: 1000}
    - {r: b, c: y, v: 0.5}
encoding: {x: c, y: r, color: v}
```
